Roof area calculator Plan area × pitch · handles pitch changes

Enter each roof section's plan (footprint) area and its pitch. Roof area = plan area × slope factor √(144 + pitch²) ⁄ 12. Add a row for every pitch change — main, porch, lean-to. Then push the total into the roof override above.

Standalone takeoff calculators — quick numbers without touching the current quote. More calculators get added here as needed.

Metal for Gable Roof Reference calc — separate from the quote

Model follows vCalc "Metal for Gable Roof": panels cut to the slope + overhang, foam closure = 4 × ridge (both sides of ridge + both eaves), snow guard = 2 × ridge, screws ≈ 0.75/ft². Confirm against a professional estimate and local code.

Metal Siding for Gable Ends Reference calc — separate from the quote

Shop standard: 6" per panel (vCalc's own default is 3"). Matches the main takeoff.
Model follows vCalc "Metal Siding for Gable Ends" with the shop panel layout: stepped pairs from both corners to the peak (matches the Materials list), 6" cut allowance standard. Screws at 75 per 100 ft². Doors/windows not deducted.

Metal Panels for Shed Roof Reference calc — separate from the quote

Model follows vCalc "Metal Panels for Shed Roof": single slope, panel run = span along the pitch + front & back overhangs + margin of error. Runs longer than max panel length split into equal courses. Angle trim covers the high edge + eave; rake (gable) trim covers the 2 side edges. Screws ≈ 0.75/ft².

Sheathing for a Wall Reference calc — separate from the quote

vCalc uses none (straight area ÷ 32). The main takeoff's Zip lines carry 10% — set 10 to compare apples to apples.
Model follows vCalc "Sheathing for a Wall": 4×8 sheets = L × H ÷ 32 ft², rounded up. One wall — multiply or run each wall separately.

Studs for a Wall Reference calc — separate from the quote

Model follows vCalc "Studs for a Wall": studs = (L ÷ spacing) + 1, rounded up. Field studs for ONE straight wall — corners, T-intersections, and opening king/jack studs are extra. Plate rows shown for convenience (vCalc excludes them).

Pricing master Cost is the only stored price · sell auto-bumps from one markup

Enter materials with cost only. The sell price is cost × your one materials markup. Change it any time — every price across the tool recalculates instantly.

The single markup on materials. Sell = cost × (1 + this/100). 10% → cost × 1.10
Used only for the counter ticket / retail reference — not applied to project quotes.
